related.title: EDFA 串接：ASE 雜訊累積
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學等效SNR至少18 dB且誤差模型成立才通過；0.20組失敗，非AWGN誤差不回報成量測SNR。 iq_errors.csv、能量和與殘差分布圖 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 20 與變更 13.9794 dB、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Require18 dB equivalent SNR and a valid error model;0.20 fails, and non-AWGN residuals must not be reported as measured SNR. iq_errors.csv, energy sums and residual-distribution plots Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 20 and changed 13.9794 dB, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學OSNR至少22 dB；4段通過、8段不足；多段不等增益時必須改用逐段模型。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching minimum OSNR22 dB:4 spans pass and8 fail; unequal gains require a span-by-span model.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成正規化EVM由0.10變0.20；參考星座平均能量固定為1。 名義式 10*log10(1/0.1**2) = 20 dB；變更式 10*log10(1/0.2**2) = 13.9794 dB。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 從每點複數誤差平方平均算EVM，再用總信號能量/總誤差能量重算；保留旋轉與增益校正方式。
合成單段OSNR為30 dB、同一參考頻寬；比較4與8等效段，不計非線性雜訊。 名義式 30-10*log10(4) = 23.9794 dB；變更式 30-10*log10(8) = 20.9691 dB。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 將每段雜訊轉線性相加後回dB；把參考頻寬與訊號量測頻寬單獨列出。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic normalized EVM changes from0.10 to0.20 with unit mean reference-symbol energy. Nominal 10*log10(1/0.1**2) = 20 dB; changed 10*log10(1/0.2**2) = 13.9794 dB. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Compute EVM from per-symbol squared complex errors and cross-check total signal/error energy; retain phase/gain normalization rules.

Synthetic single-span OSNR30 dB in the same reference bandwidth; compare4 and8 equivalent spans, neglecting nonlinear noise. Nominal 30-10*log10(4) = 23.9794 dB; changed 30-10*log10(8) = 20.9691 dB. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Sum linear noise powers then return to dB; distinguish the noise reference bandwidth from signal integration bandwidth.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: EPON MPCP：授權公平性與 Jain 指標
related.titleEn: EPON MPCP: grant fairness and Jain index
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學等效SNR至少18 dB且誤差模型成立才通過；0.20組失敗，非AWGN誤差不回報成量測SNR。 iq_errors.csv、能量和與殘差分布圖 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 20 與變更 13.9794 dB、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Require18 dB equivalent SNR and a valid error model;0.20 fails, and non-AWGN residuals must not be reported as measured SNR. iq_errors.csv, energy sums and residual-distribution plots Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 20 and changed 13.9794 dB, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 本題等權教學門檻J≥0.9；第一組通過、第二組未通過；加權服務需另定公平基準。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. For this equal-weight exercise requireJ≥0.9: first passes and second fails; weighted service needs a different reference.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成正規化EVM由0.10變0.20；參考星座平均能量固定為1。 名義式 10*log10(1/0.1**2) = 20 dB；變更式 10*log10(1/0.2**2) = 13.9794 dB。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 從每點複數誤差平方平均算EVM，再用總信號能量/總誤差能量重算；保留旋轉與增益校正方式。

合成4ONU額度[1,1,1,1]與[1,1,1,3]，單位都是kB/round，四者需求都足夠。 名義式 (1+1+1+1)**2/(4*(1+1+1+1)) = 1 Jain index；變更式 (1+1+1+3)**2/(4*(1+1+1+9)) = 0.75 Jain index。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 直接列每ONU平方與總和；將全部額度乘10後指標應不變，驗證量綱不變性。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic normalized EVM changes from0.10 to0.20 with unit mean reference-symbol energy. Nominal 10*log10(1/0.1**2) = 20 dB; changed 10*log10(1/0.2**2) = 13.9794 dB. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Compute EVM from per-symbol squared complex errors and cross-check total signal/error energy; retain phase/gain normalization rules.

Synthetic four-ONU grants[1,1,1,1] and[1,1,1,3] kB/round, all with sufficient demand. Nominal (1+1+1+1)**2/(4*(1+1+1+1)) = 1 Jain index; changed (1+1+1+3)**2/(4*(1+1+1+9)) = 0.75 Jain index. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Tabulate individual squares and totals; multiply all grants by10 and verify scale invariance.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
